[EN] Rebels to the left, monsters to the right, and feuding princesses and witches to top things off.

And people complain about being stationed in Val Palrada?
[ES] Rebeldes a la izquierda, monstruos a la derecha, y princesas y brujas enemistadas para rematar.

¿Y la gente se queja de estar apostada en Val Palrada?
